title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are a fast-growing, Y Combinator-backed SaaS startup operating at the intersection of AI and enterprise sales automation. Our platform helps distributors and manufacturers eliminate lost deals by automating quoting and order processing end-to-end — integrating directly with major ERP and CRM systems. We're a small, high-output team and we move fast.

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer with a founder mindset to build AI-powered systems end-to-end. This is a hands-on, high-agency role for someone who loves owning architecture decisions, shipping production-grade software, and working across the entire stack.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture and design of AI systems from concept to production.

  • Collaborate with a talented cross-functional engineering team across the full stack.

  • Build robust data pipelines to process large-scale unstructured data efficiently.

  • Deploy and manage software in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Make the backend scalable, stable, and performant.

  • Develop scalable, reusable frontend components and API structures.

  • Write clean, maintainable code with well-considered testing strategies (unit and integration).

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Proficiency building end-to-end AI-powered web applications using Next.js / React on the frontend and Python on the backend.

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to join a pre-seed AI-powered construction tech startup in Berlin as one of the founding engineers. You'll work on a browser-based platform that uses AI to automate complex building design workflows — including technical building equipment (TGA) planning and electrical schematic generation — reducing planning timelines from weeks to hours.

As an early Software Engineer, you'll have real influence over architecture, tooling, and infrastructure decisions. You'll help shape the core backend and plugin architecture, deliver prototypes, and drive the MVP to production-readiness across multiple ecosystems.

What You'll Do

  • Contribute to the design and delivery of prototypes for AI-powered building design features.

  • Drive the MVP to production-readiness across multiple software ecosystems (including integrations with tools such as Revit).

  • Process and handle large quantities of CAD data at scale.

  • Help define backend and plugin architecture, as well as infrastructure setup.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code with strong CS fundamentals.

  • Deliver solutions that span multiple platforms and ecosystems.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Proficiency in C# or Python for backend software development.

Strongly preferred:

  • Experience with CAD data processing and implementing data structures and algorit
